title: Simulating + interactive 3D Foliage / Grass!
author: UverseDev
selftext:
This is heavily inspired by "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild", but with combination of inspiration with Wall-E. Altho, I might change the main character for something else for better fitting to the natural environment lol.   
  
What I've been mainly working on is Foliage (Grass) Simulation of which I added in Uverse (my own Game Engine) directly, and then I used it for this project, of which I am developing and focusing now! The grass is highly interactive with the wind itself, highly customizable with the different grass colors, dryness, batches and of course, it also supports collision system to interact the grass with object. This is something I always wanted implement it for the past 15 years (when I was very young game dev), but only now I implemented it for the first time and I feel proud of this work. \^\^

All code + 3d assets has been generated by Uverse's AI "Orbit"

If you have questions, shoot either here in comment or in DM! :)
